title: SAIL-VOS: Semantic Amodal Instance Level Video Object Segmentation -- A Synthetic Dataset and Baselines
abstract: Builds a synthetic GTA-V video dataset with pixel-accurate visible and amodal masks, semantics and instance identities, and studies amodal instance-level video segmentation. The data provides roughly 1.8 million object annotations without requiring human amodal-mask drawing.

title: WALT: Watch and Learn 2D Amodal Representation from Time-Lapse Imagery
abstract: Automatically mines previously unoccluded objects in fixed-view time-lapse imagery and composites them to form object, occluder and occluded layers. It learns a layered 2D amodal representation and reports gains for occluded people and vehicle detection/segmentation, without manually drawing occlusion labels.

title: Learning to Track with Object Permanence
abstract: Adds spatiotemporal recurrent memory to a tracking-by-detection system to retain object locations and identities through full occlusion. It uses synthetic tracking video with ground truth for invisible objects and joint synthetic-real training, then evaluates on KITTI and MOT17.

title: Tracking through Containers and Occluders in the Wild
abstract: TCOW studies causal tracking through heavy occlusion and containment. Its Kubric clips give target, frontmost-occluder and outermost-container X-ray masks, allowing supervision beyond a target mask and separating occlusion from containment.

title: TAO-Amodal: A Benchmark for Tracking Any Object Amodally
abstract: Introduces a tracking benchmark with modal and amodal boxes for visible, partially occluded, fully occluded and partially out-of-frame objects across 833 categories. It reports that modal trackers and existing amodal approaches struggle under heavy occlusion.

title: CoTracker3: Simpler and Better Point Tracking by Pseudo-Labelling Real Videos
abstract: Pretrains a point tracker synthetically, then trains trajectory coordinates from pseudo-labelled real video generated by frozen teachers. The authors avoid supervising noisy real-video confidence/visibility labels and freeze their visibility head during that phase.

title: Segment Anything, Even Occluded
abstract: SAMEO adapts EfficientSAM into a detachable amodal mask decoder driven by modal or amodal detector boxes. It freezes image and prompt encoders, trains the decoder with Dice, focal and IoU losses, and generates clean/occluded Amodal-LVIS pairs; it supports RTMDet-like detector inputs.

title: Using Diffusion Priors for Video Amodal Segmentation
abstract: DiffVAS uses Stable Video Diffusion for two-stage amodal mask and RGB completion from modal-mask sequences and pseudo-depth. It makes occluded pairs by masking initially almost-complete objects with random mask sequences, but its reported training setup is materially heavier than a detector auxiliary head.

title: Track Anything Behind Everything: Zero-Shot Amodal Video Object Segmentation
abstract: TABE chains SAM2 visible object segmentation, depth-derived target regions, video-diffusion outpainting and a second segmentation pass. Its TABE-51 data composites independently recorded target and occluder clips to obtain exact hidden-mask ground truth and cautions that ordinary visible-mask scores can reward re-identification instead of completion.
